quests.title: Genetics Researcher Expedition
quests.description: Unravel the mysteries of heredity and genetic engineering!

story.introduction: The Genetics Research Institute has discovered unusual inheritance patterns! Use your knowledge of genetics to solve these biological mysteries.

steps.title: DNA Fingerprinting Investigation
steps.narrative: Dr. Gene shows you DNA samples that need analysis. Use genetic principles to solve the case!

problem.question: In a dihybrid cross between AaBb × AaBb, what is the phenotypic ratio?
problem.explanation: In a dihybrid cross, the phenotypic ratio is 9:3:3:1, representing the different combinations of dominant and recessive traits.
